newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha quiet as buyers/sellers stand apart.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha quiet as buyers/sellers stand apart.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady in quiet trade, but bid/ask ranges widened on Friday as crude futures came under some pressure from weaker gas oil.
Traders said supportive buying during the week had disappeared, leaving an abundant supply of small cargoes unsold.
"Generally the Med market is stronger, so few North African cargoes are reaching NWE, but there are plenty of 5-10kt cargoes available," a trader with a major petrochemical company said.
Four or five small Russian cargoes were seen available with more to come in early October. Bids for these were reported at mean of benchmark cif quotes but buyers and sellers stood apart.
